statement: The Z3 Δ-learned hybrid-accuracy screening panel satisfies the Hard Materials Z3 adsorption-energy acceptance test (MAE <= 0.1 eV) on a held-out benchmark.

premises.statement: The content-addressed adsorption reference panel reports MAE against experimental references on a held-out benchmark, below the 0.1 eV Z3 ceiling.

lean_theorem.reason: No Lean theorem proves the empirical adsorption-energy aggregate MAE; the available theorems formalize consequences of error, not the measurement itself.

runtime_gate.reason: No deployed runtime gate consumes the Hard Materials Z3 aggregate adsorption-accuracy measurement.

excluded_scope: Adsorption accuracy for models other than the Δ-learned hybrid stack
Structures or chemistries outside the held-out reference panel
Operando reconstruction effects, coverage effects, solvent effects, and finite-temperature corrections
Catalyst screening hit-rate claims beyond the accuracy acceptance test
